result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated localization key is exposed as a section heading on the home feed.

issues.description: The section heading above Tokumaru Ramen Bar displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title, unlike the correctly rendered 'Fastest near you' heading above it.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization lookup for this section so the translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') is rendered, add a fallback title if the key is missing, and add a check to prevent untranslated keys from being shown in production.
